criteria.text: Reproduce and identify the audio source separately on mobile and Electron, documenting the actual trigger and affected build(s).
criteria.reason: Requires audible verification on a physical iPhone and the actual Electron app.

criteria.text: With working sounds disabled, normal text turns produce no recurring processing bell in either client, including streaming, tool activity, reconnect, and repeated turns.
criteria.reason: Requires audible verification on a physical iPhone and the actual Electron app.

criteria.text: Processing audio is opt-in; document the treatment of default-enabled versus explicitly saved user preferences instead of silently discarding intentional choices.
criteria.test_id: legacy preference snapshots migrate once, preserving unrelated choices and subsequent opt-ins

criteria.text: Disabling processing audio during an active turn stops it promptly. The off preference persists after relaunch.
criteria.reason: Requires audible verification on a physical iPhone and relaunch timing in the actual app.

criteria.text: Any retained opt-in loop stops on completion, cancellation, failure, and the relevant session/lifecycle transitions; replayed events do not create duplicate or orphaned playback.
criteria.test_id: rendered provider sound lifecycle respects preference, selected session, voice, cancellation, errors and app state

criteria.text: Intentional voice output and configured approval/completion alerts continue to work, without globally muting the OS or suppressing needed notifications.
criteria.reason: Requires audible verification of speech, approval, and completion alerts on the physical clients.
